items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I was there when Charlie Barnet tried to hire me in '38... they wanted to hire me to come with Charlie Barnet

ctx.x: Yeah, that was nextdoor to the Muelbach Hotel. We played there. In fact, I was there when Charlie Barnet tried to hire me in '38. But the Continental had another name before that. But they were doing very poorly, and then they started bringing bands in, and they gave it the name Continental. But the same guy, Eddie Spitz and them, Randazzas owned it, you know. Eddie and Jack Landaser.
You haven't up to this point -- where do you meet Walter Page?
